summary: Two independent read-only reviews of canonical design v7 found four in-scope P1 architecture gaps: fork-safe one-use dispatch, externally anchored authority activation, descriptor-bound terminal publication, and a complete staged replay runtime/import/native closure. M7, real fit, archival replay, and final OOS remain sealed.

limitations: The independent reviewers were read-only and did not mutate product code, tests, contracts, gates, ledgers, or historical evidence.
No training, server replay, budget consumption, real PIT certification, or final-OOS access occurred.

blockers: M7 derived-contract freeze, real M7 fit, CCC/Gate experiments, archival replay, and final OOS remain prohibited until the replacement design passes independent review.
